title: session.json of a session recorded as session-audio/v2
description: What a schema cannot say is on the contract's page: that `started` is the instant 0 of the session's clock, that an absent `stopped` means still recording or ended by a crash, and that a track named here has its file.

instant.description: ISO 8601 with the local offset, as the page says: the page's promise, not this schema's — no reader reads its shape today.

changed.description: Each change of device after the first, in order: `at`, seconds on the session's clock, as clock.jsonl's; `device`, the name the system gave the device from then on, or null when it named none.
